title: Blooming Canvas
description: This datapack adds 7 new flower paintings
body:
# 🌸 Blooming Canvas - 7 New Flower Paintings

Bring a touch of nature into your world! This **texturepack/datapack** adds **7 unique 2x2 block flower paintings** that brighten up any room, garden, or cozy nook.  

Each painting is crafted to capture **colorful, aesthetic floral vibes**, from delicate wildflowers to vibrant bouquets. Perfect for players who love decorating their Minecraft worlds with charm and creativity.  

✨ **Features:**  
- 7 brand-new, hand-designed flower paintings  
- Each painting: 2x2 blocks  
- Ideal for decorating interiors, gardens, and outdoor spaces  
- Easy to install and compatible with most Minecraft versions  
  WARNING: You need both the datapack and the resource pack for everything to work.

🌷 **Add a blooming touch to your world today!**
